gate1.baseline_artifact: docs/backtesting.md current canonical baseline and same-run before_metrics inside this artifact

runtime_fields: source rows entry_date/exit_date/pnl for prior closed maturity score

gate3.note: Default-off paper allocator only; core signals/survival unchanged.

gate4.note: Even if numeric Gate 4 passes, this runner is not accepted alpha because the shared daily allocator helper was not changed.

hypothesis: candidate_pool/allocation: accepted allocator same-day source conflicts may be improved by an ex-ante source-maturity score computed only from source-family trades whose exit_date is before the signal date, allowing the allocator to prefer recently proven sources while falling back to fixed priority when history is too thin.
interpretation: The source-maturity allocator failed the accepted allocator comparison; no strategy or production behavior is retained.
next_retry_requires: shared helper plus daily parity if any source-maturity field is promoted

parameters.fallback: accepted fixed source priority when no same-day row has enough history

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping source-maturity lookback, min history, win-rate weight, source rank, top-N, notional, hold days, or cooldown on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.negative_reflection: If rejected, the source-maturity field chased noisy source family history and did not explain the oracle gap. If positive, the result remains non-accepted because shared helper parity is missing.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A valid retry needs closed forward source-competition rows or a materially richer PIT source-quality field such as relation age, independent confirmation freshness, or source-specific replacement value recorded in daily snapshots.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Recent source-family performance was either too thin or too noisy to arbitrate same-day source conflicts better than the accepted fixed priority. The oracle gap from exp-20260613-003 is not explained by this simple trailing closed-PnL maturity field.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool/allocation: accepted allocator same-day source conflicts may be improved by an ex-ante source-maturity score computed only from source-family trades whose exit_date is before the signal date, allowing the allocator to prefer recently proven sources while falling back to fixed priority when history is too thin.

2_history_check.exp-20260611-005: Current accepted source-priority allocator with lagged consensus; aggregate EV +2.1849 and PnL +$40,397.21 is the binding comparator.
2_history_check.exp-20260611-010: Industry-laggard source pruning was replay-positive versus core but not promoted; do not simply delete or reprioritize sources.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-002: Industry-stable state router failed direct comparison versus the accepted allocator.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-003: Observed-only source-choice oracle found a material gap, but used future PnL and required a PIT source-arbitration field.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. The variant must improve aggregate EV/PnL versus the same-run accepted allocator control, avoid direct EV/PnL window regressions, beat the accepted exp-20260611-005 comparator, and pass sample/survival/drawdown/concentration guards. Because this runner does not change the shared daily helper, a positive result is a lead only.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260613-003 showed a large same-day source-choice oracle gap, but prior direct rank/state router retunes failed; a PIT trailing closed-outcome score is a materially different source-maturity field, with high risk of noisy performance chasing.

execution_envelope.notes: Same accepted-helper allocator bucket as exp-20260612-024. This scout does not change production; positive evidence would require a shared helper and daily snapshot parity before retention.

production_impact.parity_note: Replay-only source-maturity scout. It reuses accepted allocator source rows and only uses prior closed source-family outcomes at each signal date. No source priority, helper, daily snapshot, report, ranking, sizing, exit, watchlist, LLM/news, or order surface is changed.
